            case (state)

                default: state <= A; // Default case (should not happen)
            endcase
        end
    end

module pipelined_multiplier (
    input clk, rst,
    input [7:0] a, b,
    output reg [15:0] out
);

    reg [15:0] partial_product [0:7]; // Stage 1: Partial products
    reg [15:0] stage2_sum;             // Stage 2: Accumulated sum
    reg [15:0] stage3_result;          // Stage 3: Final result

    integer i;

    // Stage 1: Compute partial products
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                partial_product[i] <= 16'b0;
            end
        end else begin
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                partial_product[i] <= a[i] ? (b << i) : 16'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // Stage 2: Accumulate partial products
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            stage2_sum <= 16'b0;
        end else begin
            stage2_sum <= partial_product[0] + partial_product[1] +
                          partial_product[2] + partial_product[3] +
                          partial_product[4] + partial_product[5] +
                          partial_product[6] + partial_product[7];
        end
    end

    // Stage 3: Final output
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            out <= 16'b0;
        end else begin
            out <= stage2_sum;
        end
    end

endmodule
